title: Amethyst
body:
Amethyst is a new ore that is used to craft a couple of new blocks, mainly Ward Stones, Silent Stones and Beacons.

* Beacons do not give effects; they only create a beam of light used for navigation
* Ward Stones stop hostile mobs from spawning in a radius, similar to light sources but without emitting light. They also work through walls
* Silent Stones make nearby passive mobs silent
